title: GitHub Coordination
summary: GitHub Issues as required live coordination for normal delivery: claim authority and its migration from pushed Task-branch claims, the Issue graph and composed views, room binding and fresh-host continuation, and the deferred extended-outage recovery.
importance: It changes which owner holds live assignment state for every role and supersedes ADR-000O at a reviewed cutover; mistakes would create two claim authorities or let Issue text enlarge authority.
